links.outcome: Patient anxiety (GAD-7), emotion, illness perception, satisfaction, physician workload (NASA-TLX), and communication time, AI-assisted vs standard communication
links.quote: AI-assisted patients reported significantly lower post-communication anxiety (GAD-7, 3.2 [2.7] vs. 5.7 [3.1]; P = 0.001) and better emotion, illness perceptions, and satisfaction.

unlisted_practices: Using a locally deployed LLM to generate personalized answers to patient questions before routine face-to-face preoperative communication to reduce anxiety and physician workload

screen.reason: This is a randomized controlled trial testing the clinical impact of an LLM-assisted preoperative communication intervention versus standard care on patient anxiety and physician workload. It evaluates the AI intervention as a whole rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice variation.
